response.body:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<multistatus xmlns="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav">
  <response>
    <href>/gal/</href>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <resourcetype></resourcetype>
        <displayname>Global Address List</displayname>
        <getcontenttype>text/vcard</getcontenttype>
        <addressbook-description xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav">Company directory (read-only)</addressbook-description>
        <supported-address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav">
          <address-data-type xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav" content-type="text/vcard" version="3.0"></address-data-type>
        </supported-address-data>
        <supported-report-set>
          <supported-report>
            <report><ADDRESSBOOK:addressbook-query xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"/></report>
          </supported-report>
          <supported-report>
            <report><ADDRESSBOOK:addressbook-multiget xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"/></report>
          </supported-report>
          <supported-report>
            <report><sync-collection xmlns="DAV:"/></report>
          </supported-report>
        </supported-report-set>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</status>
    </propstat>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <getetag></getetag>
        <getcontentlength></getcontentlength>
        <address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"></address-data>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found</status>
    </propstat>
  </response>
  <response>
    <href>/gal/u<user-b>.vcf</href>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <displayname>cal5-other</displayname>
        <getetag>"u<user-b>-1925089446000000"</getetag>
        <getcontenttype>text/vcard; charset=utf-8</getcontenttype>
        <address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav">BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
UID:setjoin-gal-u<user-b>
FN:cal5-other
N:Other;Bob;;;
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK,PREF:cal5-other@oracle-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
 bbbbb.test
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:alias@oracle-bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb.test
TEL;TYPE=WORK:+15550101
TITLE:Manager
KIND:individual
PRODID:-//Mailserver//CardDAV//EN
REV:20310102T030406Z
END:VCARD
</address-data>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</status>
    </propstat>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <resourcetype></resourcetype>
        <addressbook-description xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"></addressbook-description>
        <supported-address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"></supported-address-data>
        <supported-report-set></supported-report-set>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found</status>
    </propstat>
  </response>
  <response>
    <href>/gal/u<user-a>.vcf</href>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <displayname>cal5-owner</displayname>
        <getetag>"u<user-a>-1925089445000000"</getetag>
        <getcontenttype>text/vcard; charset=utf-8</getcontenttype>
        <address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav">BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
UID:setjoin-gal-u<user-a>
FN:cal5-owner
N:Owner;Alice;;;
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK,PREF:cal5-owner@oracle-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
 aaaaa.test
EMAIL;TYPE=INTERNET,WORK:alice@upn.example.test
TEL;TYPE=WORK:+15550100
TITLE:Engineer
X-MANAGER:cal5-other
KIND:individual
PRODID:-//Mailserver//CardDAV//EN
REV:20310102T030405Z
END:VCARD
</address-data>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 200 OK</status>
    </propstat>
    <propstat>
      <prop>
        <resourcetype></resourcetype>
        <addressbook-description xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"></addressbook-description>
        <supported-address-data xmlns="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:carddav"></supported-address-data>
        <supported-report-set></supported-report-set>
      </prop>
      <status>HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found</status>
    </propstat>
  </response>
</multistatus>

content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' wss: https: http:; media-src 'self' blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'self' blob:; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none';
permissions-policy: camera=(self), microphone=(self), autoplay=(self), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), magnetometer=(), gyroscope=(), accelerometer=()
